title: Oncoskill evidence claim
description: Metadata for one clinical claim bundled in a pack or reference. Every clinical statement Oncoskill relies on offline must carry this, so it can show how current it is and refuse to call it current after review_due without a live check.

statement.description: The claim in plain, source-faithful language. No invented numbers.

source.description: Human-readable source name (matches an entry in research/source-ledger.yaml).

source_version.description: Edition/version/year of the source, e.g. 'ESMO bone sarcoma CPG 2018 (Suppl 4)'.

evidence_type.description: Where it sits in the source hierarchy.

strength.description: Honest strength. Do NOT use 'rct-proven' unless a randomized trial literally supports it.

jurisdiction.description: Where it applies, e.g. 'EU', 'US', 'global', or a country code. Helps flag applicability.

applicability.description: Who/what situation it applies to and notable exceptions (e.g. 'skull-base, incompletely resected; not low-grade fully resected').

verified_at.description: ISO date this claim was last checked against the live primary source.

review_due.description: ISO date after which the skill must not call this current without a live check.

supersedes.description: claim_id of an earlier claim this replaces, if any.

confidence.description: Verification confidence (e.g. lower if the source page was bot-blocked).
